page_title: BOL 2-0 FIO | Bologna v Fiorentina 14/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+5' 2 - 0 Goal! Charalampos Lykogiannis puts a cross into the box and finds Jens Odgaard (Bologna), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
90+4' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+2' That's a clear yellow card. Stefan Posch (Bologna) goes into the book.
90+2' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
88' It's time for a substitution. Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) comes on in place of Victor Kristiansen.
88' Here is a change. Joshua Zirkzee is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
87' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
85' Federico Ravaglia makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) after a cross from the side.
83' Today's match ends for Arthur Melo who will be replaced by Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina).
83' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina).
83' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
81' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is brought on as a substitute for Riccardo Orsolini.
79' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) replaces Alexis Saelemaekers.
78' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies well wide of the left post.
76' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
75' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
74' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
72' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
71' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nicolas Gonzalez walks off the pitch to be replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina).
70' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) replacing Michel Aebischer.
70' Michael Kayode (Fiorentina) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.

68' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the bottom left corner, but Federico Ravaglia denies him with a great save.
67' Remo Freuler (Bologna) jumps into a tackle and Daniele Chiffi signals a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick from a promising distance.
67' Total attempts – 12:4.
66' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Pietro Terracciano is alert and denies him.
64' Sam Beukema (Bologna) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
64' The referee awards a corner and Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes over to take it.
63' An attempted cross from Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is cleared.
60' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Federico Ravaglia intercepts the ball.
59' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniele Chiffi had an easy-decision to make.
57' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
56' The substitution is prepared. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giacomo Bonaventura.
56' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
54' Fiorentina are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
52' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared Pietro Terracciano (Fiorentina).
51' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
47' The shot by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Pietro Terracciano.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' Daniele Chiffi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Daniele Chiffi couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Remo Freuler (Bologna) and blew his whistle.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Bologna keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
40' The goal by Bologna won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
38' Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi has indicated he is going to review the Bologna goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

36' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
35' What was Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
31' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
29' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Chiffi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
26' Close! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
25' The rebound finds Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance!
25' Pietro Terracciano blocks Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna)'s effort from the edge of the box.
23' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
20' Some neat passing and movement from Bologna as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
18' The Fiorentina players can’t believe it after referee Daniele Chiffi signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
16' There's a break in play and referee Daniele Chiffi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Fiorentina using VAR. This could be interesting!
16' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Fiorentina for a penalty. Play continues.
15' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
14' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Federico Ravaglia makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
12' 1 - 0 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Pietro Terracciano with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
10' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
8' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
6' A sweet pass inside the box gives Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
3' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi will supervise the game today.
